blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defending champion Creamline remained unscathed after overcoming the strong challenge of ZUS Coffee, 25-19, 16-25, 26-24, 25-17, to keep their share of the lead in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. The Cool Smashers’ depth continued to spell the difference in the 10th season celebration of the league, with Bernadeth Pons playing her best game since her comeback from Asian Games beach volleyball with a game-high 16 points on top of 14 excellent receptions.
